feature: Ask AI in the uploaded-image workspace
scope: Advice only. No design edits, stitch generation, export or safety-check changes. Native typed-text chat is not included.
privacy: Explicit consent per send; two artwork images, question and at most three previous exchanges. No API keys in the browser. Conversation is page-memory only.
